title: Crisis Communications 101

reader_summary.headline: In this Evergreen episode from April 2017.
reader_summary.overview: In this Evergreen episode from April 2017, we dig into the basics of crisis communications with A16Z's long-time operating partner for marketing, Margaret Wenmockers. This hallway-style discussion covers everything from making a plan before a crisis happens, to what actually constitutes a crisis. Because ultimately, every crisis is an opportunity for companies to change their cultures and become a better business.

thesis: The episode argues that a crisis is defined as anything negatively impacting a business or its perception, ranging from negative press to major events like an oil spill, rather than just internal issues or minor social media incidents. It emphasizes that effective crisis management requires pre-baked cultural values of honesty, transparency, and urgency, along with a proactive executive team that maintains a paranoid awareness to identify potential crises before they escalate.
